title: Partial Modification of the provisions of Guidelines on Standardization in Health Insurance
full_text:
> **Giaiddffll INSURANCE REGULATORY AND ir.lai DEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY OF INDIA** 





## Ref: IRDA/HL T/REG/CIR/006/01/2017 

10<sup>th</sup> January, 2017 

# **To** 

## **All Insurers** 

## **_Re: Partial Modification of the provisions of Guidelines on Standardization in Health Insurance_** 

Reference is invited to the provisions of Guidelines on Standardization in Health Insurance notified vide ref: IRDA/HLT/REG/CIR/146/07/2016 dated 29<sup>th</sup> July, 2016: In partial modification, Clause (1) of Chapter V shall be replaced with the following and shall be read as under: 

- _(1) "All Yearly returns shall be furnished within 90 days from the close of the Financial Year."_ 

Insurers are advised to make a note of the above and ensure compliance.
